name: Industrial Environment LoS Day 2
shortDescription: Line-of-Sight (LoS) area in the [Arena2036](https://www.arena2036.de/) research factory campus environment.
longDescription: Same as `dichasus-ca0x`, but measured on the second day with different reference transmitter channel and a different environment outside the measurement area (for example, a car body was moved to stand just outside of the measurement area).
warnings: This dataset is currently still in the process of being analyzed. It will be published once complete.

Due to a configuration error, we are unable to provide high-quality CSI data for all 32 antennas and at all locations. We had to disable certain antennas (as indicated below) and some transmitter locations are missing.

csi.description: Channel coefficients for all antennas, over all subcarriers, real and imaginary parts

snr.description: Signal-to-Noise ratio estimates for all antennas

pos-tachy.description: Position of transmitter determined by a tachymeter pointed at a prism mounted on top of the antenna, in meters (X / Y / Z coordinates)

gt-interp-age-tachy.description: Time in seconds to closest known tachymeter position. Indicates quality of linear interpolation.

time.description: Timestamp since start of measurement campaign, in seconds

photos.description: The Arena 2036 factory floor. The measurement area is on the right at the very back of the hall. Source: ARENA2036 e.V.
Industiral equipment (e.g., forklifts, car bodies, machines, ...) was placed outside of the measurement area (unfortunately, we were not allowed to take pictures of everything).
The measurement was carried out in a corner of the Arena 2036 factory building.
A tachymeter was used to precisely track the position of the prism on top of the transmit antenna.
The robot with an ADALM-Pluto SDR as main transmitter and the antenna on top of a pole.
